plain.text: "LORD, who may live in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?" The answer: the person whose way of life is blameless, who does what is right and speaks the truth from their heart. They do not slander, do no wrong to their neighbour, and do not spread gossip. They despise evil but honour those who fear the LORD. They keep their promises even when it hurts. They lend money without charging interest and do not take bribes against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.

summary.bigIdea: Those who come close to God live with integrity: truthful, kind to neighbours, and faithful to their word.
points: The psalm asks who may come near to God.
The answer describes honest speech and fair treatment of others.
Such a person will never be shaken.
summary.reflection: Which one of the qualities in this psalm would you most like God to grow in you?
